figurative_meaning_en: In a negative sense: a friend who is a bad influence, forming deep but superficial friendship often based on alcohol
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো একবোতলের বন্ধু, আসল বিপদে কখনো পাশে থাকে না।
পার্টিতে মিললে একবোতলের বন্ধু হয়ে যায়, কিন্তু দৈনন্দিন জীবনে কোনো যোগাযোগ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He is just a one-bottle friend; he never stands by you in real trouble.
They become one-bottle friends at parties, but there's no contact in daily life.
note: This idiom highlights superficial bonds in Bengali social culture, often critiquing alcohol-fueled relationships.
